messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks"
set: ["symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks", "your symptoms may not improve for up to several weeks", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "it may take up to 2 weeks before symptoms improve", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve", "up to 5 weeks", "dose may change once symptoms improve", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve after 6 weeks", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects", "up to 2 to 3 weeks", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve", "symptoms may improve before infection is completely cleared", "up to 2 or 3 weeks for muscle spasm", "given for up to 8 weeks while esophagus heals", "full effect for depression may take 4 weeks or longer"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
